outcome: mode of delivery preference before and after the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic
cohort: 200 nulliparous pregnant women attending health centers in Ahvaz, Iran for routine prenatal care
finding: Higher health anxiety and prenatal distress scores in pregnant women during the COVID-19 pandemic were significantly associated with a higher probability of choosing cesarean section as the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Women with higher health anxiety and prenatal distress scores were significantly more likely to choose cesarean section after the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic.
